analysis.title: Interdependence: The Invisible Threads of a Community
analysis.description: Educational slide illustrating ecological interdependence through three circular nodes arranged triangularly around a glowing ring (Predation, Mutualism, Parasitism), followed by a key takeaway banner at the bottom.
analysis.layout: The title spans across the top. Below the title, three circular graphic callouts are arranged in a triangular configuration connected by glowing orange thread graphics: Predation at top-centre, Mutualism at lower-left, and Parasitism at lower-right. A summarizing banner sits horizontally along the bottom centre.

components.visibleText: Interdependence: The Invisible Threads of a Community

Predation
Species rely on others for food. If prey numbers fall, predator numbers soon follow.

Mutualism
Both species benefit from the interaction.

Parasitism
One species benefits at the expense of the host.
Within a community, every species depends on other species for food, shelter, pollination, or seed dispersal.
